jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

About The Role

McKesson is seeking a strategic and results-driven Director, SAP Finance Transformation & Enterprise Solutions
to lead large-scale finance transformation initiatives across General Ledger, Treasury, and enterprise finance capabilities. This leader will drive business and technology modernization efforts, develop strategic roadmaps, and partner with business stakeholders to deliver innovative SAP S/4HANA solutions that improve efficiency, scalability, compliance, and business outcomes.

The role combines finance process expertise, solution architecture leadership, transformational program management, and business consulting capabilities to enable McKesson's long-term growth strategy.

What You'll Do

Lead enterprise-wide finance transformation initiatives involving Record-to-Report (R2R), and related finance processes.
Define and execute strategic roadmaps for SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities and supporting technology platforms.
Serve as the solution architecture leader for complex finance and treasury initiatives, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards.
Build compelling business cases, investment analyses, and value realization strategies that support executive decision-making.
Partner with business leaders, finance organizations, and technology teams to identify opportunities for process optimization and digital transformation.
Lead large cross-functional programs from strategy through implementation, change adoption, and business value realization.
Oversee integrations between SAP S/4HANA Finance and upstream/downstream business processes, including MM (Materials Management) and SD (Sales & Distribution).
Influence executive stakeholders, vendors, and delivery partners to achieve strategic business objectives.

Basic Requirements

10+ years of progressive experience in finance technology, finance transformation, enterprise applications, or consulting leadership roles.
Hands-on experience with Record to Report and Treasury business processes and supporting technology solutions.
Experience leading SAP S/4HANA transformation programs within large, complex enterprises.
Experience implementing or supporting SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions.
Experience with SAP Finance configuration and integrations across MM and SD modules.
Proven Solution Architecture experience designing enterprise finance technology solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including development of business cases, investment justification, and value realization frameworks.
Bachelor's degree in information technology, Business, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Skills/Experience

Consulting experience in business process transformation, operating model design, or corporate strategy.
Knowledge of Treasury Management, Cash Management, Financial Close, Accounting Operations, and Financial Planning processes.
Experience working with Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Procurement, and Supply Chain functions.
Familiarity with enterprise integration platforms, APIs, cloud technologies, and modern architecture frameworks.
Experience managing strategic technology vendors and system integrators.
Advanced degree (MBA, MS, or related discipline).
Experience within healthcare, pharmaceutical, distribution, or regulated industries.

jobs.description:
Permanent Full Time

We are looking for a Director, Technology Delivery – Finance & Actuarial
to lead technology delivery across our Finance and Actuarial portfolio.

This is a leadership role spanning technology strategy, portfolio delivery, modernisation, operations and people. The Director will partner with business and technology leaders to shape multi-year technology roadmaps, deliver complex change and ensure the portfolio remains secure, resilient and positioned to support evolving business priorities.

The successful candidate will bring strong technology leadership, strategic thinking and delivery experience, with the ability to connect business priorities, technology direction and execution. They will operate effectively at both the strategic and delivery levels, build strong teams and partnerships, and bring clarity and accountability to a complex portfolio.

What you will do:

Lead technology delivery across the Finance and Actuarial portfolio, ensuring investment and delivery align with business priorities and strategic outcomes.
Partner with Finance and Actuarial leaders to translate business strategy into multi-year technology roadmaps, investment priorities and executable plans.
Help shape and execute the technology strategy for the portfolio, aligned with enterprise architecture and broader technology priorities.
Provide technology leadership across complex initiatives, from strategy, architecture and solution design through implementation, transition and ongoing operations.
Lead cross-functional teams spanning architecture, engineering, data, integration, security, operations and programme delivery.
Provide clear leadership across scope, funding, sequencing, dependencies, technology risk and delivery trade-offs.
Drive portfolio modernisation, reducing legacy complexity and technical debt while improving resilience, scalability and maintainability.
Ensure technology solutions are secure, sustainable and aligned with enterprise architecture, engineering, security and regulatory standards.
Build strong relationships across business and technology teams to manage dependencies and deliver integrated outcomes.
Lead strategic vendor and technology partner relationships, ensuring clear accountability for outcomes, quality, value and delivery commitments.
Drive portfolio planning and prioritisation, balancing transformation investment with modernisation, technical health, regulatory requirements and operational priorities.
Use portfolio, delivery and operational metrics to understand performance, identify opportunities and drive continuous improvement.
Build and develop high-performing teams, growing technical capability, developing future leaders and creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Provide senior leaders with clear visibility into portfolio health, investment requirements, key decisions, risks and outcomes.

What you will bring:

Post-secondary education in computer science, engineering, business or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Significant progressive experience in technology leadership and delivery, including leading and developing high-performing teams.
Demonstrated experience developing and executing technology strategies and multi-year roadmaps.
Strong delivery leadership, with the ability to translate business priorities into technology outcomes and drive complex initiatives through to delivery.
Experience leading complex initiatives across applications, data, integration, security and technology infrastructure.
Strong business, technical and architectural judgement, with the ability to balance strategic direction with pragmatic delivery decisions.
Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships, influence across organisational boundaries and solve complex business problems through technology.
Experience with portfolio planning, investment prioritisation, financial management and vendor management.
Ability to navigate ambiguity, challenge existing approaches and make pragmatic decisions that balance business outcomes, risk, cost, quality and speed.
Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to make complex technology topics understandable to both technical and non-technical audiences.
A bias for action, curiosity and critical thinking, with the ability to adapt as business and technology priorities evolve.
A growth mindset and commitment to continuous learning and improvement.

What will set you apart:

Experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programmes involving significant business, process and technology change.
Experience leading technology within Finance and/or Actuarial environments, or other complex financial-services functions.
Experience with ERP transformation or modernisation, with SAP S/4HANA experience considered a strong asset.
Experience working across global business segments and technology teams, navigating different priorities and operating models to deliver enterprise-wide outcomes.
Experience leading geographically distributed teams and working with global delivery models.
A track record of turning technology strategy and roadmaps into measurable business outcomes.

jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

Role Summary

The AVP Technology Lead – Digital is a strategic technology leader responsible for enabling, scaling, and modernizing Sun Life Canada’s shared digital platforms that support secure, connected, and frictionless Client and advisor experiences. This role provides technology leadership across core digital assets including Secure Web, Public Web, & Secure Mobile, and related enablement platforms such as client identity and access management, and an internal design system.

The role combines strategic leadership, technical oversight, people leadership, delivery execution, operational accountability, and vendor/financial management to drive technology excellence and measurable business value. The AVP partners closely with Product, Client Experience, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Operations, Engineering, and Business leaders to ensure digital assets are resilient, scalable, secure, reusable, and aligned to enterprise priorities.

This role operates in a complex, high-visibility environment where digital platform reliability, modernization, and cross-business enablement are critical to Client outcomes. The leader must be able to bring clarity to a broad mandate, make decisions in ambiguity, and build a high-performing technology organization that balances speed, stability, security, and long-term platform health.

What will you do?

Technology Strategy, Platform Enablement & Engineering
Shape, communicate, and align the digital technology strategy across business units, ensuring it supports near-term delivery commitments and longer-term modernization objectives.
Partner with Business Leads, Product, Client Experience, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Operations, and Enterprise Technology to define platform roadmaps, OKRs, sequencing, and investment priorities.
Provide thought leadership on the evolution of shared digital platforms, including identity, web, mobile, integration, data enablement, and reusable digital capabilities.
Promote technology stack standards, modern engineering practices, automation, and architectural discipline, balancing build vs. buy vs. partner decisions in a complex technology ecosystem.
Ensure design and engineering decisions account for reusability, scalability, security, maintainability, accessibility, and technical debt reduction.
Create the conditions for exceptional digital experiences by enabling business and product teams with reliable, scalable, secure, and reusable platforms.
Platform Delivery & Execution
Accountable for end-to-end delivery of digital platform capabilities, including oversight of internal delivery teams, vendors, system integrators, and total cost of ownership.
Drive delivery excellence by improving velocity, quality, reliability, predictability, and agile maturity across multiple squads.
Track delivery metrics, identify bottlenecks, and implement targeted productivity and delivery maturity improvements.
Serve as the primary escalation point for platform, delivery, vendor, and dependency-related issues, enabling rapid resolution in a complex environment.
Ensure delivery is integrated across product, architecture, engineering, operations, cybersecurity, and business priorities.
Embed test-and-learn, automation, and continuous improvement practices to improve speed, quality, and sustainability.
People Leadership & Capability Development
Lead, mentor, and develop technology leaders and teams, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, accountable, and execution-focused culture.
Design and optimize team structures to support clear ownership, delivery outcomes, modernization priorities, and clear accountabilities.
Partner with Chapter, Engineering, Product, and Business leaders on workforce planning, role clarity, succession planning, and capability development.
Build internal capability in digital engineering, enablement, agile delivery, vendor management, and operational excellence.
Coach leaders to manage performance effectively, clarify ownership, and build resilient teams through change and transformation.
Financial & Vendor Management
Lead budget management, including annual planning, cost tracking, capitalization, forecasting, and investment prioritization.
Manage strategic vendor and system integrator relationships, holding partners accountable for delivery quality, outcomes, knowledge transfer, and value realization.
Drive cost transparency and technology spend optimization across applications, infrastructure, security, vendor, and platform investments.
Identify opportunities to reduce long-term dependency on external partners while strengthening internal platform ownership and capability.
Operational Excellence, Risk & Security
Ensure stability, security, technology currency, resiliency, and end-of-life decommissioning for applications within scope.
Establish governance processes that balance speed of delivery with risk management, audit, regulatory, cybersecurity, and control requirements.
Partner with Application Operations to ensure effective incident management, change management, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
Proactively manage operational risk, application health, technical debt, and service reliability across shared digital capabilities.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
Act as a strategic technology partner to leaders across Product, Client Experience, Business, Operations, Architecture, Cybersecurity, and Enterprise Technology.
Communicate digital strategy, delivery status, risks, trade-offs, and dependencies with clarity and transparency.
Represent the Digital technology function in executive forums, bringing enterprise perspective, external insight, and pragmatic recommendations.
Strengthen alignment between technology investments, business priorities, Client experience outcomes, and enterprise digital strategy.

Accountabilities

Align digital strategy with business objectives, Client outcomes, enterprise standards, and shared technology priorities.
Define and monitor roadmaps, OKRs, modernization priorities, and delivery sequencing.
Oversee execution across delivery teams, vendors, system integrators, and enterprise partners.
Establish governance, track delivery metrics, and drive productivity, quality, and reliability improvements.
Manage budgets, vendor relationships, and cost optimization opportunities.
Build and sustain a high-performing, engaged, inclusive, and platform-oriented technology organization.
Ensure digital platforms are secure, scalable, resilient, reusable, and positioned to support future growth.

What you need to succeed?

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree or MBA is an asset.
10+ years of experience in senior technology leadership roles with demonstrated success delivering complex, mission-critical digital platforms.
Experience leading modernization and enablement of digital platforms such as identity, web, mobile, integration, or client/advisor experience platforms.
Proven ability to lead technology teams through transformation, platform ownership, and operating model evolution.
Strong financial acumen with experience managing sizable technology budgets, vendor portfolios, and total cost of ownership.
Strong stakeholder management, executive communication, and organizational leadership skills.
Experience in regulated financial services is valuable; depth in digital enablement, engineering excellence, and vendor-heavy delivery environments is prioritized.
As this position is posted in several locations, we specify that bilingualism (French, English, both oral and written) is required for Quebec only for the frequent interactions with English and French-speaking colleagues or internal partners across Canada or worldwide

Mindset & Behaviours

Decisive leader comfortable operating in ambiguity, complexity, and transformation.
Strong technical credibility with the ability to challenge architecture, delivery practices, platform decisions, and CI/CD approaches.
Builder mindset with equal focus on fixing, scaling, enabling, and simplifying.
Pragmatic, outcomes-driven decision-maker who balances speed, stability, risk, and long-term application health.
Collaborative leader who builds trust, drives momentum, and creates clarity across complex stakeholder groups.
Critical thinker who challenges the status quo constructively and drives continuous improvement.
Strong coaching orientation with a commitment to developing leaders, teams, and internal capability.

What’s in it for you?

A competitive salary and bonus program, based on market scale
A flexible group insurance program starting on your first day of work to meet your needs and those of your family.
Time off that allows you to focus on the moments that matter most. 20 vacation days per year.
Our Share Ownership Program gives you the opportunity to invest in Sun Life while benefiting from employer matching contributions.
We are proud to be included in Great Place to Work's 2026 list of Canada's Best Workplaces.
A warm, supportive, and inclusive culture.

Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Who We Are

For 150 years, London Health Sciences Centre (LHSC) has been a leader in world-class care. As an acute tertiary and quaternary teaching hospital, LHSC provides leading-edge medical care to people from across western Ontario and beyond. LHSC is located just two hours from Toronto and two hours from Detroit in the city of London which is known for its beautiful and walkable downtown core located on the Thames River, a vibrant culinary scene and scores of activities that highlight local arts, culture and music. Our team of more than 17,000 physicians, staff, learners and volunteers works tirelessly to support patients as they navigate their unique health-care journeys. As one of Canada’s largest acute-care teaching hospitals, LHSC is a renowned centre of innovation with a history of groundbreaking research that has influenced how people are cared for around the world. With nearly 1 million annual patient visits across University, Victoria and Children's Hospitals, LHSC provides compassionate leading-edge care and is proud of our strong regional, national and international partnerships. For more information, please visit www.lhsc.on.ca.

The Business Support team provides portfolios with operational budgeting, reporting, forecasting and analysis support. This team plays an important role in assisting LHSC leadership in making informed financial decisions, and provides sound advice in financial practices and organizational policy.

The Capital Finance team supports the capital asset needs of LHSC. The team works closely with Corporate Accounting to ensure accurate, efficient and timely recording of capital transactions. The culture of teamwork and respect drives the team to support the capital needs of patient care at LHSC.

What the Role is

The Director, Business Support and Capital Finance provides strategic and operational leadership for business management and capital planning practices across London Health Sciences Centre (LHSC) to maximize delivery of high quality, safe, and efficient patient care within available budgets. The role provides hospital-wide leadership and oversight for business planning, financial management, reporting, and control practices to safeguard organizational assets and strengthen financial performance. The Director also provides strategic financial stewardship of LHSC's capital planning, capital accounting, and capital funding activities and ensures compliance with internal and external audit requirements related to capital financial reporting.

The Director leads and drives systems transformation through encouraging and supporting innovation and championing and orchestrating change, challenging the status quo. The role leads Managers and Business Managers and develops and sustains healthy work environments and effective teams within a performance-driven culture. The Director organizes program activities, directs resources, executes operational initiatives, formulates policies and procedures, and strategically plans for the future. The Director develops purposeful coalitions with internal and external stakeholders.

Reporting to the Vice President, Finance (CFO) & Performance , the Director, Business Support and Capital will translate decisions of our senior level into execution by utilizing systems thinking strategic planning and relationship management by developing purposeful coalitions with internal and external partners. This position requires someone with a proven track record for leading and driving systems transformation through encouraging and supporting innovation and championing and orchestrating change. developing and sustaining healthy work environments and effective teams while leading in a performance-driven culture. You will organize program activities, direct resources, execute operational initiatives, formulate policies & procedures, and strategically plan for the future.

You will demonstrate strong business acumen including management of multi-million dollar operating and capital budgets. This leader will have exceptional analytical and critical thinking skills that contribute to identifying problems and issues, evaluating the interdependence of decisions, questioning and challenging the status quo, and designing and implementing processes for improvement.

You foster a healthy, safe and engaging work environment where others have meaningful opportunities to contribute, collaborate, and cooperate to achieve results. You inspire and motivate your leaders and teams by aligning with our mission, vision and values and modelling performance and service excellence. Spotting and developing talent is a strength, as is your ability to coach, mentor, support and challenge others to achieve professional and personal goals.

You are self-aware of own assumptions, values, principles, strengths and limitations
You manage and develop self while modeling qualities such as honesty, integrity, resilience, and confidence
You engage and support others to foster development, personal goals and encourage a healthy organization
You achieve results by strategically aligning direction, decisions, actions and evaluation with the vision, values and evidence

Winnipeg, Manitoba

We put our team members first. You’ll receive a great salary and benefits, and experience the support and opportunity you deserve. You’re empowered to make decisions. You control your future.

Job Description

Job Summary

The Senior Director, Financial Planning & Analysis is responsible for leading financial planning, performance analysis, and strategic financial decision support for The Boyd Group’s Corporate functions and enterprise-wide initiatives. Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis, this leader serves as a key financial advisor to senior leadership, providing the analysis, insights, and recommendations needed to support organizational priorities, improve business performance, and inform strategic decision-making.

The Senior Director leads Corporate FP&A activities, including budgeting, forecasting, expense management, workforce planning, and financial performance analysis. Working closely with Corporate functional leaders and Finance Business Partners, this role ensures financial plans reflect business priorities, establishes visibility into financial performance, and identifies opportunities to improve efficiency and resource utilization.

As a key partner to the SVP, FP&A, the Senior Director also plays a lead role in evaluating enterprise strategic initiatives and cross-functional business opportunities. This includes leading complex financial analysis, scenario modeling, business case development, and performance assessments to support enterprise decisions and measure the financial impact of strategic priorities. The Senior Director translates complex financial and operational information into clear, actionable recommendations for executive leadership.

Key Job Responsibilities

Corporate Financial Planning & Business Partnership: Lead budgeting, forecasting, workforce and expense planning, and financial performance analysis for Corporate functions. Partner with functional leaders to align resources, financial targets, and plans with business priorities.
Enterprise Strategic Initiatives & Financial Analysis: Lead financial evaluation of enterprise priorities, cross-functional initiatives, productivity opportunities, and business transformation efforts. Develop business cases, scenario models, and recommendations to inform decisions and assess financial impact.
Enterprise Performance Analysis & Decision Support: Analyze consolidated financial and operational performance, identify trends, risks, opportunities, and root causes, and work with Finance and business leaders to recommend actions that improve overall company performance.
SVP FP&A Executive Partnership: Serve as a trusted senior partner to the SVP, FP&A, coordinating complex cross-functional analysis and preparing executive-level financial insights, presentations, and recommendations for leadership reviews and strategic discussions.
FP&A Team Leadership & Capability Development: Lead and develop assigned Corporate and Strategic FP&A resources; establish analytical standards, set priorities, and strengthen financial modeling, business partnership, and executive communication capabilities.
Planning Process & Analytics Improvement: Improve the efficiency, consistency, and quality of planning, reporting, financial models, and analytics through process improvements, standardization, and automation.

Minimum Education And/or Experience Required For The Job

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, strategic finance, or a related discipline, including leadership responsibility.
Demonstrated experience leading corporate budgeting, forecasting, performance analysis, and complex financial modeling.
Experience developing business cases and financial analysis for cross-functional initiatives and enterprise-level decisions.
Experience partnering with senior leaders and leading or developing Finance professionals in a complex organization.

Required Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Strong financial and business acumen, with the ability to connect enterprise strategy, operating drivers, and financial outcomes.
Advanced financial modeling, scenario analysis, forecasting, and analytical problem-solving skills.
Ability to lead ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives and turn complex findings into clear recommendations.
Executive presence and influencing skills, including the ability to constructively challenge assumptions and build alignment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including development of executive and Board-level financial materials.
Strong people leadership, prioritization, and organizational skills across multiple competing enterprise priorities.

Preferred Education And/or Experience

MBA, CPA, or other relevant advanced degree or professional designation.
Experience in a publicly traded, multi-business, multi-location, or geographically dispersed organization.
Experience supporting enterprise transformation, long-range planning, investment analysis, or strategic performance improvement initiatives.

Other Requirements

Ability to travel within the United States and Canada as business needs require.
Occasional travel and overnight stays may be required.
Specific travel frequency and other role requirements to be confirmed with the SVP, FP&A.

As a top 10 global dairy processor, we value contributions that matter and strive to foster an inclusive, growth-driven work environment. Ready to bring your best?

Overview of the role:

Saputo is seeking a Senior Director, Revenue Management – North America.

The Senior Director, Revenue Management leads Saputo North America’s revenue management agenda across Canada and the United States to deliver sustainable, profitable growth across customers, channels, categories, and products. This role integrates pricing, trade investment, promotion effectiveness, mix and assortment, and portfolio profitability into one disciplined commercial framework. The Senior Director partners with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Category & Product Management, Commercial R&D, and Technology to translate market, customer, commodity, and cost dynamics into fact-based decisions and consistent execution.

As a senior commercial thought leader, the Senior Director establishes governance, analytics, tools, and decision forums that improve pricing accuracy, strengthen return on trade investment, accelerate insights, and build an integrated revenue management capability across Saputo North America while enabling market-specific execution in Canada and the United States.

How you will make contributions that matter:

Revenue Management Strategy & Governance

Own and evolve the Saputo North America revenue management strategy, operating model, multi-year roadmap, and performance scorecard in alignment with business and commercial priorities.
Integrate the core revenue growth levers of pricing, promotions, trade terms, mix, assortment, channel strategy, and portfolio optimization.
Align North American standards with country-specific market conditions, customer structures, commercial practices, and business priorities to drive consistency without limiting local agility.
Establish decision rights, approval thresholds, guardrails, and governance for pricing, trade investment, promotions, bids, contracts, and new business opportunities.
Define clear North American and country-level decision rights, escalation paths, and accountability across the Canadian and U.S. businesses.
Lead pricing and revenue management forums, ensuring decisions, assumptions, risks, approvals, and follow-up actions are documented and communicated.
Serve as a trusted advisor to senior Sales, Finance, Category & Product, Marketing, Operations, and Supply Chain leaders, constructively challenging assumptions and recommending action.

Pricing Strategy, Architecture & Execution

Lead market-based pricing strategies that reflect commodity movements, inflation, supply chain costs, cost-to-serve, competitive dynamics, and customer value.
Oversee periodic and event-driven price reviews, scenario modeling, financial evaluation, sales materials, customer transition plans, and execution of approved price changes.
Develop and maintain price corridors, floors, exception protocols, validation controls, and pricing policies that improve consistency and reduce value leakage.
Optimize ERP-enabled price data, maintenance routines, and controls to improve pricing accuracy, transparency, and monthly price-change execution.
Partner with Sales on complex negotiations and customer conversations, balancing profitable growth, customer needs, and volume risk.

Trade Investment & Promotion Effectiveness

Own the governance and optimization of total trade investment, including planning standards, approval criteria, accrual alignment, performance tracking, and post-event review.
Establish consistent pre- and post-promotion evaluation methods using incremental volume, revenue, margin, return on investment, and strategic objectives.
Identify non-productive spend, value leakage, and underperforming events; partner with commercial teams to redirect investment toward higher-return opportunities.
Maintain promotional guidelines and embed lessons learned into customer plans, annual planning, and future investment decisions.

Customer, Channel & Portfolio Profitability

Lead recurring diagnostics across Canada and the United States, including customers, channels, categories, brands, and SKUs to identify performance drivers, risks, and corrective actions.
Advance category and portfolio profitability by prioritizing opportunities in mix, assortment, product rationalization, and route-to-market economics.
Develop actions for the highest- and lowest-performing customers and SKUs, including margin improvement, cost-to-serve, terms, freight, and commercialization opportunities.
Create clear North American executive reporting that connects price, volume, mix, trade, freight, currency, and cost movements to net sales and margin outcomes, with visibility to consolidated and country-level performance.

New Business, Bids & Commercial Decision Support

Apply defined guardrails and scenario analysis to assess profitability, capacity, factory utilization, service requirements, risk, and incremental growth.
Maintain scalable bid and tender tools, decision records, and post-launch scorecards to confirm performance against approved business cases.

Planning, Forecasting & Performance Management

Lead in-year forecasting and scenario planning for price, volume, mix, trade, freight, commodity exposure, and customer margin performance.

Partner with Finance on close-related revenue management activities, including customer expense classification, true-ups, pricing factors, and relevant commodity or hedging impacts.

Define the North American revenue management data, reporting, and technology roadmap, including ERP, trade promotion, customer, syndicated market,.
Improve data quality, common definitions, master data, model governance, and controls so leaders can make decisions from trusted information.
Harmonize revenue management definitions, performance measures, and reporting across Canada and the United States to enable comparable insights and coordinated decision-making.
Champion responsible use of advanced analytics, automation, and AI-enabled decision support for elasticity, scenario modeling, promotion optimization, forecasting, and opportunity identification.

Drive adoption of self-service dashboards and standardized tools while preserving clear accountability for decisions and outcomes.

10+ years of progressive experience in revenue management, commercial finance, sales operations, pricing, category management, or a related commercial discipline.
